nodes.speaker: Orrin
nodes.body: Arrows, lamplight, and something to eat. Check your pack before you take the northern door. The stone is patient; you can take your time.

choices.label: How do I begin a Delve?

nodes.speaker: Orrin
nodes.body: A few essentials for the road. Buy what you need; the practice target is free to use.

nodes.speaker: Orrin
nodes.body: Use the northern doorway and choose Begin Delve when you are ready. Cancel leaves you here. Your equipment stays fixed during the run. The target in the east bay is for practice; it never starts a descent.

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: Morning! Or afternoon. Jane says I lose track when the watering starts. What can I do for you?

choices.label: Do you need help on the farm?
How do I grow those strawberries?
What can I make from the harvest?
What farming supplies do you sell?
How do you keep this place running?
Whose grave is by the trees?

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: Jane loves strawberries. I promised her some before supper, but the ordinary seeds take all day and she has never been patient. Take these six special packets. My farm is protected, so till clear grass elsewhere in the overworld, plant all six, then water them once. They should be ready in about thirty seconds—even in winter.

choices.label: I will grow them for Jane.
What if I need farming tools?

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: I sell hoes, shovels, watering cans, and every ordinary seed I can get into a paper packet. These special strawberry seeds are for the job, though. Jane says selling miracles by the sack would ruin the market.

choices.label: All right. I will grow them.

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: Good! Find clear overworld ground outside my fence, then till, plant all six, water once, and keep an eye on them. Bring me three strawberries. Jane will be delighted. She has been awfully quiet today.

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: Find clear overworld grass outside my protected farm—anywhere else on the overworld is fine. Till it with a hoe, plant all six special packets, and water once. Thirty seconds or so, in any season. Then bring three strawberries back. Do not worry if Jane does not come out to greet you. She rests a lot these days.

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: Thanks, my wife will love these. Here was one of her favourite books on gardening. I am sure she will not mind; I have not seen her reading it much lately. It has her notes for presses, barrels, and cellar casks too.

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: Jane wrote the whole chain down. Press three pieces of fruit into Must, age three Must in a Fermentation Cask, then sell the finished Bottle to Marlow. Do that and I will help mark out more room at your homestead.

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: Fruit Press first, Fermentation Cask second, Marlow last. Jane underlined that last part twice. She never trusted him around an unpriced bottle.

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: Press three Fruit, age the three Must into one Bottle, and sell it to Marlow. Jane's journal contains the station recipes if you read it from your inventory.

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: A proper first vintage! Jane would say not to drink the profits. Here is five gold for the trouble. She would have liked that too.

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: Best gardener on the island. She could shame a seed into sprouting. I still set out two mugs at breakfast. Habit is just love with nowhere urgent to be.

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: Fence keeps the cows in, gate lets good sense out. I rotate the plots, water at the roots, and talk to the pumpkins. Jane says the pumpkins are the only ones listening properly.

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: Jane picked that spot herself. Said the morning sun was lovely under those trees. I keep the flowers fresh so she has something cheerful to look at while she rests.

nodes.speaker: Farmer Bob
nodes.body: Seeds in dry packets, tools by the handle. Jane did the labels. Mine always looked like frightened worms.

nodes.speaker: Fisherman Fin
nodes.body: Quiet water, steady hands. I am Fin. If you have come to learn the lake, I can spare a rod and a little patience.

choices.label: Finish: A Place Across the Water
Remind me: A Place Across the Water
Will you teach me to fish?
Remind me how to use the rod.
What makes a good fishing spot?

nodes.speaker: Fisherman Fin
nodes.body: Take my spare rod. A small school will gather beside the dock while you learn. Select the rod, face the shadow in the water, and cast. Give the line four seconds, then it will reel. Bring me exactly three fish and the school will move on.

nodes.speaker: Fisherman Fin
nodes.body: There—the fish shadow beside the end of the dock. The planks are sound, so walk right out. Three casts, three fish. No need to rush the water.

choices.label: I will give it a try.

nodes.speaker: Fisherman Fin
nodes.body: Equip the spare rod and aim at the fish shadow beside the dock. Cast once for each fish and wait for the reel. The school leaves after your third catch.

nodes.speaker: Fisherman Fin
nodes.body: Good work. Keep the rod. Take my Fish & Fire Handbook too—it records the rod pattern and how to cook a catch at a campfire. Read it from your inventory to add the shortcuts to your recipe guide.

nodes.speaker: Fisherman Fin
nodes.body: Look for a moving shadow in deep water. Pools hold only so many catches and later settle elsewhere. Dexterity helps you land a better haul, but even the finest angler cannot fish an empty pool.

nodes.speaker: Fisherman Fin
nodes.body: The ferry beside me goes to Willowharbour for free. Visit the landing and speak with Pip just north of it. Either of us can sign off your arrival for 150 bronze.

choices.label: I would like to do that.

nodes.speaker: Fisherman Fin
nodes.body: Use the ferry beside this dock. Speak with Pip just north of the Willowharbour landing; you can finish with Pip without returning here.

nodes.speaker: Fisherman Fin
nodes.body: Visit the landing and speak with Pip just north of it. The harbour square and shops are west of the landing. The return ferry is free.

nodes.speaker: Fisherman Fin
nodes.body: Arrival registered. Here is your 150 bronze. Pip can introduce you to Rowan, the village carpenter.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: Well met, traveller. Tools wear out, supplies wander off, and I make sure neither keeps you down for long.

choices.label: Hey you, yes you, I need your help.
Let me see what you have to offer.
What have you seen on the island?

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: There's a very important book I need, and I am far too old to take the journey to fetch it. Will you help an old man out?

choices.label: No, I have other things to do.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: It's just in the tent over there, on the table in the corner.

choices.label: Really? It's just over there though...

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: Yes, just there. But it is an exceptionally important journey, and I have an exceptionally important fire to watch.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: Splendid. You'll find it on the table inside my tent. Mind the dimensional threshold.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: Fair enough then. The tent is not getting any farther away.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: The book is on the table in my tent. Yes, that tent. The one right over there.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: Thanks... Oh, wait, I've already read this one. Here, you keep it. Take 1 gold for the trouble, too.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: A working estate needs a product worth returning for. Press three pieces of fruit into Must, age that Must in a Fermentation Cask, then sell me the finished Bottle. You can use any stations you already own. There is five gold in it for you when you return.

choices.label: I will make the first Bottle.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: Good. Fruit Press to make Must and Pomace. Three Must go into the Fermentation Cask. Bring the Bottle to my shop when it is ready.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: Press three Fruit, age the three Must into one Bottle, then sell the Bottle here. The Pomace is yours to reinvest elsewhere.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: There it is: fruit into craft, craft into coin, coin into the estate. Five gold, as promised. Spend it wisely.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: Tools, lights, arrows, and honest coin for anything useful you bring me. Gold, silver, and bronze stay safely in your purse.

choices.label: Let me see what you have to offer.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: I follow the safer paths, but even those change. Farmer Bob keeps a little holding to the south-east, around 382 east, 378 south. He knows more about soil than I ever will. Keep a lantern close after sunset and never trust a quiet cliff edge.

choices.label: Let me see what you have to offer.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: Buy a deed here, select it on your hotbar, aim at a clear patch of overworld grass, and press F. That claims your homestead. Use the tent entrance to visit it and the south gate to return.

choices.label: Let me see what you have to offer.

nodes.speaker: Marlow
nodes.body: Take your time. I buy useful goods as readily as I sell them.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: Welcome to the Wayfarers Archive. A good expedition begins with a question and a little preparation.

choices.label: Show me your utility equipment plans.
Finish: Stone from the Cinder Shore
Remind me: Stone from the Cinder Shore
Finish: An Opening on the Ash Shore
An Opening on the Ash Shore
Remind me: An Opening on the Ash Shore
Finish: Ready for the Ash Shore
Remind me: Ready for the Ash Shore

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: Train a skill node before relying on equipment to improve it. Eligible epic and legendary gear can exceed a trained node cap, within the equipment bonus limits. Changing gear never spends your skill points.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: Equip a usable weapon in Main Hand and armor in Body. Bows need ten matching shots in your hotbar or backpack. I will pay you 200 bronze when ready.

choices.label: I would like to do that.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: Your current equipment counts. Bram sells starter gear. Open your inventory to equip Main Hand and Body; bows need ten carried shots. Return for inspection.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: Keep your weapon and body armor equipped for inspection. A broken weapon does not count. Bows need ten shots in your hotbar or active backpack.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: Here is 200 bronze. Iona has a first expedition contract. Read enemy tells and keep an escape route; this inspection is only a starting point.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: Take the free ferry to Cinderwake. Help clear the two ember slimes east of landing at Ash Shore. Earn an eligible camp reward, then return for 300 bronze.

choices.label: I would like to do that.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: Accept first, then clear Ash Shore. Keep two basalt: collect your Expedition Reward [O] before returning. Full bags leave the loot reserved; clear credit is separate.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: Ash Shore is east of Cinderwake landing. Help defeat both slimes and earn a camp reward. Collect Expedition Reward [O] and keep two basalt for me.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: Here is 300 bronze. Keep your two basalt from the camp reward. I have a short delivery contract for those stones; already-carried basalt counts.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: Bring me two basalt for the archive and earn 200 bronze. Your Ash Shore reward contains them. Stones you already carry count; I take them only on completion.

choices.label: I would like to do that.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: If you already carry two basalt, complete the delivery below. Otherwise collect your reserved Expedition Reward [O]. Leave room in your bags, then return.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: I need two basalt. Check your reserved Expedition Reward [O] from Ash Shore. Bring them in your inventory; this delivery consumes two stones.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: Two stones for the archive, and 200 bronze for you. That finishes the first expedition introductions. The higher terraces can wait until you are ready.

nodes.speaker: Iona
nodes.body: These plans suit a peaceful trade. Each pendant uses iron, wood and fibre; no volcanic materials are needed.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.body: Measure twice, then give the wood a chance. I keep timber and the essentials for a working estate.

choices.label: Finish: A Corner to Call Home
Remind me: A Corner to Call Home

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.body: Your estate is the place to build. Public streets and shop floors belong to the village.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.body: Take your time. Prices are in bronze, with change kept in your purse.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.body: I am Rowan, the carpenter. Let us start with an introduction to furniture plans and room building. There is 150 bronze toward your first project.

choices.label: I would like to do that.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.body: We have met, so the introduction is ready to complete below. You can buy finished furniture or reusable plans, then build inside your residence.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.body: Meet Rowan inside the carpenter workshop. Finished furniture and reusable plans lead to the same pieces. Construction stays inside your purchased residence rooms.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.body: Here is your 150 bronze. Keep space around your doors, and start with a few useful pieces. Furniture plans are reusable; room expansions add building space.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.body: Place a seat, table, lamp and rug in your own residence's original room. Buy pieces or craft from reusable plans. Keep all four placed to earn 350 bronze.

choices.label: I would like to do that.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.body: Existing pieces count. Use B inside your residence to furnish the original room. Table lamps need support. Return here when the seat, table, lamp and rug are placed.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.body: Keep a seat, table, lamp and rug in the original room. Rugs fit under furniture. Floor lamps and supported table lamps count, even unlit. Your builders can help.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.body: Here is your 350 bronze. Your furniture stays in your home; this contract pays once. A place to rest makes the next journey easier.

nodes.speaker: Nell
nodes.body: A hot meal makes a better travelling companion than an empty stomach. What can I prepare for you?

nodes.speaker: Nell
nodes.body: Cooked food restores hunger. Pack a meal before the crossing; it is easier to prepare here than in the ash.

nodes.speaker: Nell
nodes.body: Take your time. Prices are in bronze, with change kept in your purse.

nodes.speaker: Ada
nodes.body: A room should feel lived in. Start with somewhere to keep your things and a little light.

nodes.speaker: Ada
nodes.body: Ready-made furnishings and crafted pieces should fit the same room. Check the space you have before you buy.

nodes.speaker: Ada
nodes.body: Take your time. Prices are in bronze, with change kept in your purse.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.body: Willowharbour, safely ashore. The square and shops are just west of the landing.

choices.label: Finish: A Place Across the Water
Remind me: A Place Across the Water

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.body: Use the ferry dock to choose Orchard or Cinderwake. Passage is free, including the trip home. Cinderwake has dangerous enemies beyond its protected landing. The Delve cave is back on Orchard.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.body: Welcome to Willowharbour. I can register your arrival and introduce you to the village. There is 150 bronze to help you settle in.

choices.label: I would like to do that.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.body: You are here, and we have met. Your arrival is ready to sign off; choose Complete the introduction below.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.body: Visit the landing and speak with Pip just north of it. The harbour square and shops are west of the landing. The return ferry is free.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.body: Arrival registered. Here is your 150 bronze. Pip can introduce you to Rowan, the village carpenter.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.body: Rowan runs the carpenter workshop west of the harbour, around the village square. Meet Rowan and ask about plans and room building. Rowan or I can finish the introduction for 150 bronze.

choices.label: I would like to do that.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.body: Find Rowan inside the carpenter workshop. Rowan can finish the introduction there; you do not need to walk back here.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.body: Meet Rowan inside the carpenter workshop. Finished furniture and reusable plans lead to the same pieces. Construction stays inside your purchased residence rooms.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.body: Here is your 150 bronze. Keep space around your doors, and start with a few useful pieces. Furniture plans are reusable; room expansions add building space.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.body: Welcome to the Willow Lantern. Find a table, share a little news, and let the harbour wait for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.body: Nell tends the kitchen in the rear of the inn. The shops around the square are open whenever you need them.

nodes.speaker: Mara
nodes.body: Take your time. Prices are in bronze, with change kept in your purse.

nodes.speaker: Otto
nodes.body: There is always another job in the yard. I am taking a moment before I remember the next one.

nodes.speaker: Otto
nodes.body: You can make your living growing and trading. The volcanic island is there when you want an expedition, not a toll on village life.

nodes.speaker: Fern
nodes.body: These little gardens keep me busy. I like a village that leaves room for things to grow.

nodes.speaker: Fern
nodes.body: The greenhouse and farmyards lie to the south. A few useful plants can make an ordinary patch of ground feel like home.

nodes.speaker: Wren
nodes.body: I came for a season and stayed for the orchard. You can probably guess how that happened.

nodes.speaker: Wren
nodes.body: The paths lead back to the square. Follow them east if you are looking for the workshops.

nodes.speaker: Ellis
nodes.body: Iona lent me another book. I only meant to stop for an hour.

nodes.speaker: Ellis
nodes.body: The archive is north of the square. Ask about equipment before paying for a piece you do not understand.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.body: Shorehand gear is a sound beginning. Try the fit before you take it across to Cinderwake.

choices.label: Finish: Ready for the Ash Shore
Remind me: Ready for the Ash Shore

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.body: Equipment can add stats and selected skill ranks. It does not grant earned levels, skill points, prerequisites, or tool knowledge. Higher-quality pieces belong to later work and expeditions.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.body: Take your time. Prices are in bronze, with change kept in your purse.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.body: Equip a usable weapon in Main Hand and armor in Body. Bows need ten matching shots in your hotbar or backpack. I will pay you 200 bronze when ready.

choices.label: I would like to do that.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.body: Your current equipment counts. Bram sells starter gear. Open your inventory to equip Main Hand and Body; bows need ten carried shots. Return for inspection.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.body: Keep your weapon and body armor equipped for inspection. A broken weapon does not count. Bows need ten shots in your hotbar or active backpack.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.body: Here is 200 bronze. Iona has a first expedition contract. Read enemy tells and keep an escape route; this inspection is only a starting point.

nodes.speaker: Tavi
nodes.body: Seeds, everyday tools, and the little things that never seem to stay in a pack. What are you short of?

nodes.speaker: Tavi
nodes.body: A quiet season in the fields can pay for a comfortable home. You do not need to fight to trade here.

nodes.speaker: Tavi
nodes.body: Take your time. Prices are in bronze, with change kept in your purse.
